name: AGIBOT X2 Basic
summary:
X2 Basic is an entry configuration in AgiBot's compact humanoid family, intended for expressive interaction, programmed movement and demonstrations. The X2 platform combines spoken communication with gestures, facial expression and responses to visual or touch input, supporting activities such as dancing, presentations and visitor engagement.

description.en:
X2 Basic is an entry configuration in AgiBot's compact humanoid family, intended for expressive interaction, programmed movement and demonstrations. The X2 platform combines spoken communication with gestures, facial expression and responses to visual or touch input, supporting activities such as dancing, presentations and visitor engagement.

Equipment differs across the X2 range. AgiBot identifies autonomous navigation, advanced obstacle avoidance and certain hand or sensing options with higher configurations, so those functions should not be assumed to be included in the Basic package. Its suitability for development work depends on the interfaces and accessories supplied with the specific unit.
